title: Heat moves from a warmer object to a cooler one
summary: Heat transfer is energy moving from a warmer object to a cooler object.
body: A NASA educator guide says heat transfer is the movement of energy from a warmer object to a cooler object. The guide states that direction and does not add a sentence that the two objects finish at one shared reading. This card is only that direction. It does not name the paths the energy can take.

sources.title: NASA's Our World: Insulators, educator guide EG-2010-06-008-LaRC
sources.author: NASA
sources.note: NASA eClips educator guide, U.S. government work, public domain. Product code dated June 2010. Supports heat transfer from a warmer object to a cooler object, and names conduction, convection, and radiation.
